title: Nightly UI Fixes
description: Two UI changes from the 2026-10-11 nightly report. Reaction windows no longer show the engine's raw ids (ability:empyrean:aetherpassage:SYSTEM_ACTIVATED:after) for faction abilities and leaders: the engine labels them with the printed name and the window, ids unchanged. The 'Prepared ... Confirm / Choose myself' bar docks at the bottom of the board column instead of covering the head of the token panel. Mocked fixtures; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CW.
